description: We are Team Quantex2, Computer Science and Engineering students from NITER, Bangladesh, working on Challenge 9: Harmonization of MODIS and VIIRS Hot Spots. Our project, Chronofire, harmonizes NASA FIRMS wildfire detections from MODIS and VIIRS into one consistent long-term record. We are interested in satellite data, data processing, and visualization. We welcome members with skills in Python, data analysis, geospatial mapping, or UI design.
